failure_modes: Conditioning directly on completion can destroy martingale centering; the proof uses predictable padding instead.
A direction chosen after observing its sign need not generate a martingale difference.
This energy argument alone supplies neither oracle accuracy nor an end-to-end SOSP guarantee.
content.goal_pattern: Bound expected total squared direct-chord lengths without paying the drift-count factor for randomly signed curvature motion.
content.key_choice: Restart after q gradient moves rather than q total moves. At stopping boundaries use predictable zero padding before applying martingale isometry to a deterministic dyadic partition.
content.key_relation: E sum_(I in T)||sum_(t in I)(a_t+m_t)||^2 <= C L_M [q E sum_t||a_t||^2 + E sum_t||m_t||^2]. The same estimate sums over stopping-time epochs under the same cap/integrability conventions.
proof_skeleton: At each dyadic level created intervals are disjoint. On each interval Cauchy–Schwarz gives ||sum a_t||^2 <= q sum||a_t||^2; sum over that level.
If tau_ep is the stopping-time epoch length, set mtilde_t=1{t<=tau_ep}m_t. The indicator is measurable before move t, so these remain martingale differences.

Enlarge the created complete intervals to the deterministic level partition of the capped timeline. Every created interval has the same padded and original sum; adding the other nonnegative squared norms gives pathwise domination. Martingale isometry bounds the expected padded level sum by E sum||m_t||^2.

Use ||u+v||^2<=2||u||^2+2||v||^2 and sum over at most L_M levels. For random epoch starts condition on the past, reindex future moves, apply the same estimate and average; nonnegative sums justify aggregation.
content.required_inputs: An adaptive epoch of at most deterministic M physical moves, x_t-x_(t-1)=a_t+m_t, at most q nonzero a_t, and square-integrable martingale differences m_t relative to a filtration containing move type, direction and size before the fresh sign. Epoch termination is a stopping time. T is the set of complete intervals created by its binary counter; L_M=1+ceil(log2(M+1)).
transfer_obligations: Verify predictable stopping indicators and conditional centering for the filtration actually used.
Select curvature direction and length before drawing the independent Rademacher sign.
Establish square integrability, the deterministic physical cap and at most q drift moves per epoch.
Re-establish the complete-interval domination if a different online partition is used.
